theme.description: The color theme to use (e.g., 'default', 'light'). See meli-themes(5).

use_color.description: Enable colored output. Overrides NO_COLOR environment variable.

editor_command.description: The command used to edit messages. Defaults to EDITOR env var or a fallback.

accounts.description: List of account configurations for meli. See meli.conf(5) for account fields.

accounts.items.description: Placeholder for list items. This field is ignored; the actual structure is defined by the schema below for objects in the list.

accounts.address.description: The email address for the account.

accounts.credentials_file.description: Path to credentials file (empty if using inline password or env vars).

accounts.vcard_folder.description: Path to vCard contacts folder (empty if not using).

accounts.mutt_alias_file.description: Path to mutt alias file (empty if not using).

accounts.default_mailbox.description: Default mailbox to open upon account initialization.
